content: Testing LLM-dependent reporting offline in R/testthat: (1) httptest2 package (CRAN) provides with_mock_api() for httr2-based packages — stores fixtures as plain-text files in test directory, replays them offline; use capture_requests() against live API once, then run suite with mocks forever. (2) without_internet() converts HTTP requests into errors that print request details — use to assert correct request formation without network. (3) Use skip_on_cran() for any test requiring a live API or real provider key. (4) Use skip_if_not_installed('httptest2') before mock tests so CI without httptest2 skips cleanly. (5) For report generation tests: separate testing the rendered-file content (snapshot tests on text fixtures) from testing the live render call (skip_on_cran + skip_if_not_installed('rmarkdown')). (6) Test the grounding guard deterministically by constructing mock Advice objects with known mismatched evidence entries and asserting they are dropped. (7) Snapshot testing with testthat::expect_snapshot() captures stable offline output deterministically.
